title: DNA-based personalised nutrition
summary: Diet recommendations tailored to your genes.
whyItFails: Weak science. Genetic signals for diet are mostly small. One-time purchase. Test once, no recurring revenue. Privacy concerns. Genetic data sharing worries consumers.
whatWouldChange: Continuous measurement (glucose, microbiome) with stronger evidence.

attempts.notes: Consumer genetic testing; disclosed a major data breach in 2023, filed Chapter 11 in March 2025, and was sold to a nonprofit founded by its co-founder.

attempts.outcome: Dropped by Campbell Soup and sold to Viome

reasons.detail: Weak science: Genetic signals for diet are mostly small.
One-time purchase: Test once, no recurring revenue.
Privacy concerns: Genetic data sharing worries consumers.
